adjudicated_statement: Work over C with Q-coefficients. Let C_aff be the smooth connected affine curve obtained from the smooth projective model Cbar of y^3=x(x-1) by deleting the three ramification points of the degree-three x-map: Cbar has genus one by Riemann-Hurwitz, H_c^2(C_aff;Q)=Q(-1) of type (1,1), and Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C_aff;Q) is isomorphic to H^1(Cbar;Q) of types (1,0) and (0,1). Let S=C_aff^8, a smooth connected affine C-scheme of dimension 8, in particular reduced, locally Noetherian, separated, and of finite type. Compact-support Kunneth of mixed Hodge structures places a nonzero Hodge type-(8,4) class in Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S;Q), arising from the summand Q(-1)^{tensor 4} tensor (Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C_aff;Q))^{tensor 4}. Let (C_0,gamma_0) be a simply-branched balanced type-(i) geometric fibre of H^bal (existence by FND-0172, equivalently Bujokas-Patel: the Casnati-Ekedahl bundle of a general cover in H_{d,g} is balanced for g>=(d-3)(d-1), hence at (d,g)=(4,6)). The constant (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family over S with this fibre is an allowed ATT-0112 clause-(E) base: its classifying image is a single type-(i) point, hence not contained in the type-(ii) locus. For this family, U isomorphic to S times U_0 and Z isomorphic to S times Z_0, where U_0 is the reduced-support open in |L_0| isomorphic to P^2, a smooth connected surface, so H_c^4(U_0;Q)=Q(-2) of type (2,2). Compact-support Kunneth therefore realises Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S;Q)(-2) as a direct mixed-Hodge-structure summand of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U;Q), carrying a nonzero Hodge type-(10,6) class (permitted by Deligne's Hodge-number bound on the 10-fold U). Finite-etale transfer over Q injects this S_6-invariant class into Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q). A finite direct sum of Q(-8) is pure of type (8,8), so Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) is not a finite direct sum of Q(-8) and T_16(Z):=W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(Z;Q), dual with no extra Tate twist, is not a finite direct sum of Q(8). Consequently the exact TASK-C66-M-004/C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem, as universally quantified over every reduced locally Noetherian C-scheme carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) genus-six degree-four family with no connected-component image contained in the type-(ii) locus and with no dimension, dominance, or non-isotriviality hypothesis, is false. The witness lies entirely in the simply-branched locus and already in the S_6-invariant ([6]) isotypic component. The class is a Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U) itself, namely the third FND-0167 corner Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2), not a lift of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(S), so FND-0171 does not block it. This does not resolve RED-0001, does not address T_16 of a dimension-17 model over a named 15-dimensional etale atlas of Hbar^bal, and does not refute the conditional implication of FND-0167, because the witness base violates (H-S) at j=6 and at j=7 (while the j=8 instance of (H-S) holds for this particular S).
contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Independent inspection of ATT-0119 sections 1-7 and of REV-0167 (CLM-0119-1 through CLM-0119-6, ATT-0119-scope-compliance, and strongest_attack) confirms the contested passage: the TASK-C66-M-004 theorem_statement quoted identically in both artifacts is universally quantified over every reduced locally Noetherian C-scheme carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family with no connected-component image in the type-(ii) locus, imposes no dimension, dominance, or non-isotriviality condition, and declares a surviving non-Tate summand in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) itself to be a disproof. The constant simply-branched type-(i) family over S=C_aff^8 meets every written hypothesis of that quantification. Hodge recomputation: for Cbar given by y^3=x(x-1), valuations of x(x-1) at 0,1,infinity are 1,1,-2, none divisible by 3, so the x-map is totally ramified at three points; Riemann-Hurwitz gives 2g-2=3(-2)+3(2)=0, g(Cbar)=1. Compact-support localization against the three-point complement (H_c^k=0 for k>=1) yields H_c^2(C_aff;Q)=Q(-1) and Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C_aff;Q) isomorphic to H^1(Cbar;Q) of types (1,0) and (0,1), matching FND-0170 and the localization sequences on the fetched Wikipedia Mixed Hodge structure page (H^2 of a smooth proper curve is Q(-1); H_c of a complement is mixed of the expected weights). Compact-support Kunneth on S=C_aff^8 forces the degree-12 corner to be four H_c^2 factors and four H_c^1 factors (2a+b=12 and a+b=8), so Gr^W_12 contains Q(-1)^{tensor 4} tensor (Gr^W_1 H_c^1)^{tensor 4} with a nonzero type-(8,4) component. For the constant family, U isomorphic to S times U_0 with U_0 a smooth connected surface (reduced-support open in |L_0| isomorphic to P^2), so Poincare duality gives H_c^4(U_0;Q)=Q(-2); equivalently localization against the discriminant curve of dimension 1 kills H_c^{>=3} of the complement and identifies H_c^4(U_0) with H^4(P^2)=Q(-2). Kunneth therefore realises Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(S)(-2) as a direct MHS summand of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U), of type (10,6). Deligne Hodge III (numdam PMIHES 1974, DOI 10.1007/BF02685881; FND-0169 already records Theorem 8.2.4(ii)) permits h^{p,q} of H_c^{16} on a 10-fold for 0<=p,q<=10, so (10,6) is allowed and is not killed by p>dim vanishing. Finite-etale transfer over Q injects the S_6-invariants, and the class is pulled back from U, hence occupies the trivial ([6]) isotypic. A finite direct sum of Q(-8) is pure of type (8,8), so this is a surviving non-Tate summand in the exact H_alpha-object of the quantified lemma. FND-0171 does not apply: that obstruction blocks transport of non-Tateness from the first FND-0167 summand Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(S) through a dimension-16 discriminant, whereas the present class is already a Kunneth summand of H_c^{16}(U) (the third FND-0167 summand), and on the product family H_c^4 of the discriminant curve vanishes. Existence of a simply-branched balanced fibre is FND-0172; independently, the fetched Bujokas-Patel Main Theorem (arXiv:1504.03756v1) states that the Casnati-Ekedahl bundle of quadrics F of a general cover in H_{d,g} is balanced whenever g>=(d-3)(d-1), which holds at (d,g)=(4,6) since 6>=3, and balanced rank-two degree-nine F is O(4)+O(5). Compatible with, and not a duplicate of, corroborated FND-0167 (conditional Tate-transfer under (H-S)/(H-C)), FND-0169 (universal (H-S) at j=8 fails on some atlas components), FND-0170 (Kummer-curve Kunneth, explicitly not transporting non-Tateness to Z), and FND-0171 (Z remained open after the j=8 attack). The original candidate text is dangerously ambiguous: S=C^8 could be misread as affine 8-space, for which H_c^{12} vanishes and the (8,4) class does not exist; the adjudicated statement therefore names C_aff. The original (H-S) clause is retained after check: on this S, j=6 gives type (8,4) and j=7 gives type (8,6) from six H_c^2 and two H_c^1 factors, so (H-S) fails at j=6 and j=7, while j=8 is eight copies of H_c^2 and is Tate Q(-8). Thus FND-0167's implication is not touched. The witness has dim Z=10, so it does not address a 15-dimensional atlas or RED-0001. Distinct from FND-0169/FND-0171: do not merge. Merge target: none. Promote candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent verification of the localization, Kunneth bookkeeping, Poincare duality on a surface, Hodge-number bound, finite-etale transfer, and Bujokas-Patel existence input.
